scope: Authored bilingual evaluation, split by questions not independent agronomic gold review. Do not tune after final results.
selection: Recall@3 on development; ties prefer no reranking, then alpha closest to0.65. Final reports recall@3, top1 evidence agreement, abstention and citation provenance, not clinical/agronomic correctness.
